## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) — true when `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (thresholds: 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000; max level 10) and `level < 10`. This is returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend also precomputes via `CharacterStateService.checkLevelUp` but overwrites with the server value. UI shows a banner in `character-sheet.component.html:66` and an ability picker in `game-console.component.html:19-28`.

**Endpoint called:** User picks an ability → `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**What changes on the character** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP: rolls class hit die (Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6) + CON modifier, added to both `max_hp` and current HP
- Chosen ability score: **+2** (uncapped — no 20 ceiling)
- AC is unaffected

The route also generates flavor text (usually fallback, bug B-03), writes a `system` log row `[Level Up] …`, and a DM history turn. Frontend then updates character state, sets `canLevelUp` false, posts a system message, and updates the campaign slot's level.
